item.text: {"batch_id":"m6_smoke-proxy-006","reviewer_kind":"codex_ai_proxy_m6_method_smoke","rows":[{"assignment_id":"no_counterexample_protocol:m2-011","method_id":"no_counterexample_protocol","sample_id":"m2-011","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"2","diagnosis":"节点 2 缺少代入与整理：仅由 x=2m+1、y=2n+1 尚未明确推出和为 2 倍整数。","repair_action":"在节点 2 前插入“x+y=(2m+1)+(2n+1)=2(m+n+1)，且 m+n+1 为整数”，再得 x+y 为偶数。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":["未启用反例协议；判断仅依据可见节点、证明文本和结构化错误证书。"]},{"assignment_id":"no_counterexample_protocol:m2-018","method_id":"no_counterexample_protocol","sample_id":"m2-018","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"2","diagnosis":"节点 1 的“分别乘以 x 和 y”不能直接保持等式；需用 x=y 的代入连接 x²、xy 与 y²。","repair_action":"将节点 1 替换为“由 x=y，左乘 x 得 x²=xy；右乘 y（或将 x 替换为 y）得 xy=y²”，节点 2 据此推出 x²=y²。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":["未启用反例协议；判断仅依据可见节点、证明文本和结构化错误证书。"]},{"assignment_id":"no_counterexample_protocol:m2-034","method_id":"no_counterexample_protocol","sample_id":"m2-034","predicted_verdict":"invalid","first_error_node":"1","diagnosis":"节点 1 错将主值平方根与平方完全互消；对负 a 有 sqrt(a²)=|a| 而非 a。节点 2“每个实数 a 都等于 |a|”也错误。","repair_action":"替换节点 1 为“a²≥0，sqrt(a²) 是平方为 a² 的非负数，故 sqrt(a²)=|a|”；删除或替换节点 2 为该结论的直接重述。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":["未启用反例协议；判断仅依据可见节点、证明文本和结构化错误证书。"]}]}
